_comment: Storyboard map for meta-create-skill VIDEO 5: The Retrospective (CP2, shown AFTER the buyer builds their first skill: v6 -> build step -> v5). 5 diagrams in teaching order, one column each, left to right. Rebuilt 2026-09-23 on the running example draft-email/ (DESIGN-SYSTEM section 9) and the one correction 'Drop the emojis and lead with the number.' Arc: Pain (this week's correction never reaches the file, so next week - in a new chat - repeats the mistake) -> Mechanism (the retrospective writes it into the file, after your yes) -> Trust (you approve every edit) -> How to ask (two things you just say, no command on the slide) -> Payoff (starts at ~80%, a strong first draft; one correction per step to work you'd put your name on). Wording lock (DESIGN-SYSTEM 9): the email draft-email/ writes is always 'this week's email'; 'next week' only names the FOLLOWING run.
hard_rule: No slash command, terminal or 'session' on any slide (DESIGN-SYSTEM 11.8 - the buyer may be on Cowork, Claude Code or Codex). The retrospective, the two ways to ask and 'your call' are ink, never a subfolder-legend colour. 01 and 02 share one layout on purpose: this week top-left, next week top-right, the file bottom-left.

columns.label: 1 - FIXING IT IN THE CHAT DOESN'T FIX THE SKILL
2 - THIS TIME, YOUR CORRECTION LANDS IN THE SKILL FILE (the retrospective, defined)
3 - IT PROPOSES THE EDIT, YOU APPROVE IT
4 - JUST SAY WHAT WENT WRONG: RIGHT AWAY, OR AT DAY'S END
5 - EVERY CORRECTION STICKS, AND THEY ADD UP
